source_geometry_adjustments: The mounting plate, enclosure, lid and cloud decoration are fixed. The crank arm and end knob are one rotating rigid assembly.
A tiny clearance pocket and shaft-boundary cap repair the fused crank-to-plate interface; the crank is moved outward by 0.005 native units.
The internal music mechanism and any free spinning grip bearing are not visible and are not inferred.
Nominal 0.22 m height and mass/inertia are estimates; preferred real winding direction is unknown.
